name: ds-rom
notes: Built with cargo (ds-rom-cli 0.8.0, rustc 1.98.1, aarch64-apple-darwin) from a source snapshot in scratchpad; snapshot has no .git so the commit is unverified. Upstream latest release v0.8.0 (2026-07-21, MIT). test.sh needs the sibling local-tools/ndstool/bin/ndstool and arm-none-eabi-gcc; it builds a tiny synthetic DS ROM, then runs dump, extract, build, extract, build and checks the round trip is byte-identical. The bundled fixtures/logogen.rs is a small generator for the synthetic header logo.
